camera.position: the lens sits at the end of Nora's outstretched right arm at chest height, completely outside the visible frame and never seen; her right arm stays extended toward the lens for the whole clip; she never reaches toward, touches, covers, taps or points at the lens
camera.framing: Nora chest-up in the right third of the foreground, facing the lens; over her left shoulder in the left two thirds of the background, about fifteen meters behind her, the two close dawn redwood trunks with the tyrannosaur standing just behind the gap between them

setting.location: Hell Creek floodplain forest, Montana, Late Cretaceous, 66 million years ago, warm humid late morning
elements: a humid riverside forest of broadleaf flowering trees and shrubs mixed with tall straight dawn redwood trunks; hazy sunlight slants in from the upper left; low ferns and leafy shrubs line a soft wet mud path with puddles; no grass anywhere; warm and humid, no snow, no frost
from frame 0 the two massive dawn redwood trunks stand about fifteen meters behind Nora with the muddy path passing between them; the gap is far narrower than the tyrannosaur's body
exactly one tyrannosaur stands just behind the gap from frame 0, too wide to pass through; it stays there for the whole clip, never appears suddenly and never vanishes
the tyrannosaur is the only animal in the frame; no birds in the frame, no other people

characters.name: Nora
characters.visual_lock: matches Nora face and Nora Body reference images exactly; honey-blonde hair tied in a high ponytail at the crown of her head, wispy curtain bangs parted in the middle, a few loose strands stuck to her damp forehead
characters.outfit: wears the exact historical outfit shown in the Nora Body reference sheet: golden-tan deer suede tunic with long sleeves that reach all the way to her wrists (never sleeveless), wide dark belt, golden-tan suede leggings the same color as the tunic that cover her legs completely from hips to boots, and criss-cross laced knee boots; no bare skin on her thighs, knees or shins at any moment (NO shearling collar, NO extra fur, NO hood, NO fringe, NO tassels, NO outfit variations)
characters.action: stands on the path facing the lens, chest heaving, flushed and laughing; for the whole clip her free left hand stays pressed flat on her chest over her racing heart and never lifts to gesture, even while she talks; she glances over her left shoulder at the tyrannosaur and back to the lens while keeping her face three-quarters toward the lens, so her mouth stays visible

characters.name: Tyrannosaur
characters.visual_lock: matches the Tyrannosaurus reference image exactly: massive boxy skull, tiny two-fingered forearms, dark grey-brown pebbly hide with faint darker stripes and a paler belly, long tail held straight out level
characters.position: stands just behind the gap between the trunks, its head and shoulders framed by them; it is huge: its head is level with the lowest branches, far above Nora's head, and its hips are higher than her head; it never touches the trunks; alive for the whole clip: chest heaving, nostrils flaring, it shifts its weight from foot to foot, takes one step to its left along the trunks and one step back to the right, and turns its head slowly over about one second; mouth closed with scaly lips covering the teeth

timeline_action.0-3s: From frame 0 Nora faces the lens, out of breath, and the tyrannosaur stands just behind the gap in the background. From the very first frame Nora speaks immediately, and glances once over her left shoulder.
timeline_action.3-7s: The tyrannosaur takes one heavy step to its left along the trunks, then one step back to the right, testing the gap without touching the trunks. Nora keeps talking to the lens, laughing between words.
timeline_action.7-10s: The tyrannosaur stands still behind the gap and slowly turns its head away, chest heaving. Nora finishes her line by about 9 seconds with a big grin; the last half second is her catching her breath.
